remarks: Welcome to refined living in the heart of New Canaan. This beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath residence offers an exceptional blend of elegance, comfort, and convenience within one of Connecticut's most sought-after communities. Sunlight fills the inviting living room, where a warm gas fireplace creates the perfect setting for cozy autumn evenings and winter gatherings. The thoughtfully designed kitchen features top-of-the-line Viking, Bosch, and Miele appliances, complemented by granite countertops-ideal for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. Upstairs, two bright guest bedrooms share a beautifully updated bath, while the private primary suite offers a peaceful retreat complete with a generous walk-in closet and a stunning marble bath. The finished lower level, with its own full private bath, provides versatile space that can easily serve as a guest suite, media room, playroom, or home office-tailored to your lifestyle. One of this home's greatest luxuries is its exceptional walkability. Stroll to the village for boutique shopping, cozy cafes, and favorite local restaurants. Meet friends for dinner, browse the farmers market, or enjoy an evening ice cream-all just moments from your front door. Additional highlights include low monthly fees, a two-car garage with storage loft, and easy access to the New Canaan Train Station with convenient rail service to New York City. Experience the ease, charm, and sophistication of New Canaan living at its finest.
